item.title: The Damaging Effects of Toxic Positivity
item.description: In a world of constant disarray, the answer to your problems is not “I’m fine.” While “it could be worse,” you are allowed to feel any and all emotions. Sometimes “looking on the brightside” is too blinding, and while “everything may happen for a reason,” can we finally stop the constant toxic positivity? It is time that we all accept the truth– It’s OK not to be OK.
